native_mechanisms: Low sun / doubled shadow: all match positions across the two ropes' crossings are revealed at once, without touching the grid cell by cell.
Corridor cost between consecutive treasures is computed arithmetically from how many knots each rope advances (index differences), never walked or filled in.
At each treasure keep only the cheapest arriving tally per slip-state (slip spent / slip whole) and drop every dominated tally.
core_technique: Banded SIMD (SSE2/SSSE3 int16) Needleman-Wunsch with a y = D + 2j coordinate transform that pre-pays the gap penalty so each row becomes a vectorized map plus log-depth prefix-maximum scan, with band width derived from a score bound obtained by a bulk popcount of main-diagonal matches.
